title: First-value loop và payment replay
scope_items: Database Migration 00009: Added home_dashboard_config (§22.14) with workspace_id, operator_mode, morning_brief_enabled, morning_brief_channels, morning_brief_time, onboarding_completed, onboarding_progress, ENABLE/FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, tenant_isolation and admin_ops_scope policies, narrow app_user/admin_user grants, and unique index idx_be_workspace_stripe_event on billing_events(workspace_id, stripe_event_id).

Acceptance Target 1 (No connector required for authorized import): Implemented IngestAuthorizedImport and ResolveUnderlyingDataRepair in Go (apps/api/internal/home/service.go) and TypeScript/SvelteKit (apps/web/src/lib/p1_first_value/index.ts, apps/web/src/routes/kinh-doanh/+page.svelte) plus mobile Home summary (apps/mobile/lib/main.dart). Accepts authorized product/order/cost/settlement imports with ConnectedAccountsCount = 0, labels imported metrics with source_class=imported and confidence_band=low when gaps exist, surfaces data-repair cards with 1 CTA and visible reason, dynamically removes repair cards when underlying gaps are resolved, redacts finance gaps for viewer role, and tracks per-user personal onboarding progress (Steps 1, 2, 5 available in P1; Steps 3, 4 unavailable; IsClosedLoopComplete=false).

Acceptance Target 2 (DST/timezone cannot double-deliver brief): Implemented EvaluateAndDeliverMorningBrief in apps/api/internal/home/morning_brief.go and evaluateMorningBriefSchedule in apps/web/src/lib/p1_first_value/index.ts using IANA timezones, bounded stale window (15m), and unique per-workspace local-date idempotency key morning_brief:<workspace_id>:<YYYY-MM-DD>. Verified across UTC day boundaries in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, Spring Forward and Fall Back DST transitions in America/New_York, and timezone changes on the same local date.

Acceptance Target 3 (Payment replay cannot double-grant): Hardened SettleStripeWebhook in apps/api/internal/billing/ledger.go and service.go (plus PostgreSQL InsertCreditLotIdempotent/InsertCreditTransaction in billing_postgres_test.go and evaluateStripeWebhookReplay in TypeScript) to enforce idempotency across both Stripe event_id AND underlying economic grant identity (external_grant_key on ai_credit_lots, idempotency_key on ai_credit_transactions, stripe_invoice_id on invoices, and checkout_session_id settlement state), while rejecting unpaid sessions.

Acceptance Target 4 (P1 pilot measurements record actual unknowns): Implemented RecordPilotObservation and EvaluatePilotCohort in apps/api/internal/home/pilot.go and evaluateP1PilotCohort in apps/web/src/lib/p1_first_value/index.ts per docs/01_business/product_strategy_validation.md and docs/06_quality_ops/analytics_event_taxonomy.md (§6). Excludes demo/internal data, deduplicates by (workspace_id, object_id, operation_id), preserves all 5 canonical confidence bands (high, medium_high, medium, low_medium, low), and records missing operator time tracking or zero accepted outputs as nil/unknown (never coerced to 0).
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestP105NoConnectorRequiredForAuthorizedImportAndDataRepair (Go -race) and P1-05 Vitest suite confirm 0-connector import, dynamic repair card removal, viewer RBAC redaction, and per-user personal onboarding progress.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestP105DSTAndTimezoneCannotDoubleDeliverMorningBrief (Go -race) and P1-05 Vitest suite confirm zero duplicate Morning Brief deliveries across UTC day crossover, America/New_York DST Spring Forward & Fall Back, and timezone shifts.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestP105PaymentReplayCannotDoubleGrant (Go -race, including concurrent replay goroutines), TestPostgresLiveCreditLotsQuotesAndBilling step 5, and P1-05 Vitest suite confirm duplicate/re-emitted webhooks never double-grant credits or duplicate invoices.

Acceptance Target 4 Verified: TestP105PilotMeasurementsRecordActualUnknowns (Go -race) and P1-05 Vitest suite confirm missing operator repair time and zero accepted outputs remain unknown/nil rather than 0.
Migration 00009 Verified: TestLoadAndValidateCanonicalP004Migration and TestUpStatusDownTransactionalBehavior in apps/api/internal/migrate/migrator_test.go pass for all 9 migrations.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: check_node.sh (svelte-check, vite build, 53 web tests + 6 admin tests), check_web_smoke.sh (real SSR HTTP 200 on /, /kham-pha, /sang-tao, /xuat-ban, /kinh-doanh), and check_flutter.sh (flutter analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings + 69 tests) all pass.
external_gates: Live Stripe Webhook & Checkout Sandbox: Production/staging Stripe webhook secret and live Stripe Checkout redirect require external Stripe credentials; webhook signature verification and replay idempotency across event_id and external_grant_key are verified locally.
Live Clerk IdP & Webhook Verification: External Clerk JWKS/Svix credentials remain an external gate.

PostgreSQL 17 Live Container in CI: CREATIVANTA_TEST_DATABASE_URL live PostgreSQL tests execute in GitHub Actions CI service containers; static SQL AST/RLS contract validation and transactional migrator tests pass locally.
remaining_scope: P2-P8: Future phase slices per docs/00_index/IMPLEMENTATION_ORDER.md and docs/00_index/AGENT_BUILD_BACKLOG.md.
decisions: Enforced Morning Brief local-date delivery identity (morning_brief:<workspace_id>:<YYYY-MM-DD>) evaluated in workspace IANA timezone with 15-minute staleness bound so DST transitions and timezone updates never double-deliver.

Enforced dual-key Stripe webhook idempotency across both stripe_event_id and economic external_grant_key (stripe_pack:<session_id> / sub_alloc:<sub_id>:<period_key>) so event redeliveries or cross-event invoice.paid notifications never double-grant credits.
Represented missing operator repair time and zero-accepted-output production cost as explicit nil/unknown values in P1 pilot cohort reporting rather than coercing to zero.
notes: P1-05 First-value loop and payment replay implemented and verified locally across Go, PostgreSQL migration 00009, SvelteKit Web, and Flutter Mobile. All 4 acceptance targets (no connector required for authorized import, DST/timezone Morning Brief idempotency, payment replay double-grant prevention, and honest unknown recording in P1 pilot measurements) are tested and passing.
